name: Big beat funk stomp
desc: Chemical Brothers-school big beat: the Funky Drummer break chopped and looped under a stomping 909 kick, Apache swapped in every fourth phrase, everything shaped toward distortion. Loud, cocky, festival-sized — peak doubles the break and opens the hats.

code.full: stack(s("<funkydrummer funkydrummer funkydrummer apache>").loopAt(2).chop(16).shape(${crunch}).gain(${gain}*.85), s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.2)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<funkydrummer funkydrummer apache funkydrummer>").loopAt(2).chop(16).shape(${crunch}).gain(${gain}*.9).lastOf(4, x=>x.rev()), s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.2), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
